subject: Annual review: Ops playbook + sensitive-case handling (draft)
content:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, emma.hrconsultant@peopleadvisors.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, rebecca@legalpartners.com
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Annual review: Ops playbook + sensitive-case handling (draft)

Hi all —

I attached a first-pass "Annual Review Ops Playbook" and a separate "Sensitive Case Checklist". Goal: land operations runbook and manager comms by Oct 20 so Talent Partners + Managers have 1 full week to review before the review window opens. High-level asks:

- Laura: exec-level comms + calibration cadence (we need a final CEO note before reviews launch).
- Markus: confirm engineering calibration board members and proposed 30-min add-on for cross-team calibration.
- Stephanie: confirm who will own the People Ops audit trail (we need an immutable record for high-sensitivity cases).
- Emma: please review the sensitive-case checklist for compliance gaps and advise on evidence collection.

Key constraints:
- We must avoid any wording that implies forced separation in manager comms; sensitive discussions should be routed to a TP + HRBP.
- Managers should not receive raw performance metrics tied to salary comps until calibration completes.

Attachments: Annual_Review_Ops_Playbook_v1.docx (playbook), Sensitive_Case_Checklist.xlsx (template for cases flagged for legal/TP), Manager_Comms_Drafts.txt (two comm versions).

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Head of People Operations | Redwood Inference
---

On Mon, Oct 11, 2026 at 10:18 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:

> Thanks Hannah — this is a solid start. A few quick items:
>
> 1) Executive comms: I think we should have a short CEO note + a separate manager guidance doc. I'll draft the CEO blurb and share by EOD Wed.
> 2) Calibration: propose we schedule an all-engineering calibration on Nov 3 (60 min) and a cross-org calibration on Nov 4 (90 min). Markus, can your team commit to producing score distributions by Oct 27?
> 3) Sensitive cases: include a two-person sign-off (TP + Legal) before anyone is notified. Rebecca (cc) can confirm legal language.
>
> I also made 3 inline comments in the playbook about timeline buffers for people on leave.
>
> Laura
>
> --
> Laura Bennett
> VP, People | Redwood Inference

On Mon, Oct 11, 2026 at 11:05 AM Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com> wrote:

> +1 on Nov 3/4. Engineering will aim to have distributions ready by Oct 26 (we can shift to Oct 27 if TP needs extra day). On the calibration board: I'll include tech leads from infra, realtime, and embeddings (names to follow).
>
> A note on sensitive cases: we need a clear data access policy for manager notes during the window. Stephanie — can we restrict manager notes to TP view-only until calibration is closed? If not, we should add a stronger language in the playbook.
>
> Markus
>
> --
> Markus Klein
> Director, Engineering | Redwood Inference

On Mon, Oct 11, 2026 at 13:42 PM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:

> Thanks all. Operational items I can own:
> - Audit trail: People Ops will create a locked folder per review case; we will record timestamps, TP owners, and any evidence uploaded.
> - Access controls: I'll work with Infra to apply view-only for manager notes until calibration completes; if infra can't support, we'll default to a manual gate.
> - Training: propose two 45-min manager office hours (Oct 28, Oct 29) focused on sensitive-case handling and comms.
>
> Questions:
> 1) Do we want TP-led templates for conversation scripts? I recommend yes for consistency.
> 2) How do we flag mid-cycle escalations to a VP? Current proposal sends TP + HRBP + manager; should we include the manager's skip-level?
>
> I'll embed these updates into Playbook v1 and re-share.
>
> Stephanie
>
> --
> Stephanie Nguyen
> People Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

On Tue, Oct 12, 2026 at 08:07 AM emma.hrconsultant@peopleadvisors.com wrote:

> Hi Hannah & team — reviewed the Sensitive_Case_Checklist.xlsx. A few compliance notes:
> - Evidence collection: ensure we capture time-stamped artifacts (chat exports, PR reviews) and a provenance field (who exported).
> - Notification language: avoid phrases that could be construed as prescriptive about outcomes. Recommend we use neutral phrasing: "We will be discussing performance and next steps."
> - Retention: recommend retaining sensitive-case artifacts for 5 years in an encrypted archive for audit readiness.
>
> I'll attach a redlined checklist by EOD Tuesday.
>
> Emma (People Advisors)

On Thu, Oct 15, 2026 at 17:48:00 -0700 Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:

> Quick update from the product leadership side:
> - Appreciate the playbook — two asks before we finalize: 1) add an explicit calibration rubric (expectation bands + examples of "meets" vs "exceeds") and 2) include guidance on how performance links to compensation bands (high-level only).
> - We should confirm a single source of truth for salary bands (Finance publishes the final mapping). Laura — can we gate manager comms until Finance confirms bands?
>
> Next steps (agreed):
> - Laura to share CEO blurb by Wed Oct 13 (status: in progress).
> - Stephanie to re-issue Playbook v1 with inline TP/Infra comments by Oct 14 (status: in progress).
> - Engineering to provide score distributions by Oct 26.
> - Final playbook and comms to be signed off by People + Legal by Oct 20.
>
> If anything here blocks launch cadence, flag to me directly.
>
> Vivek
>
> --
> Vivek Kulkarni
> VP, Product | Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs]
- Annual_Review_Ops_Playbook_v1.docx (outline, timelines, roles, escalation flow)
- Sensitive_Case_Checklist.xlsx (evidence fields, sign-off column)
- Manager_Comms_Drafts.txt (Draft A: manager guidance; Draft B: FAQ + suggested scripts)

Action items summary (thread):
- Laura: CEO blurb + confirm Finance gating (due Oct 13).
- Stephanie: update playbook with access controls, create audit folders, schedule manager office hours (due Oct 14).
- Markus: confirm calibration board members and finalize distribution export date (due Oct 26).
- Emma: redlined compliance checklist (due Oct 13).
- Vivek: confirm whether Product adds rubric + high-level comp guidance (ongoing).

If there are no objections, I'll publish the Playbook v1 link in the People Ops drive and start manager outreach next week.

Best,
Hannah
